show.description: When billionaire Dharam Khurana loses everything—including the love of his life—in a tragic twist, he’s pushed to the edge. Desperate to save her, he storms into his own bank to withdraw his locked fortune, only to be branded a fraud. What begins as a simple plea for help turns into a high-stakes heist filled with humiliation, revenge, and redemption.
